visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with pink manicured nails rests against a plain white background, featuring two red lipstick swatches on the skin. A dual-ended cotton swab is used to wipe the top swatch, demonstrating the ease of removal. Bold yellow and white text overlays appear on the top half of the screen. (2) The scene shifts to a retail drugstore interior with blurred shelves of various products visible in the background. A hand holds a black and white package labeled 'Beauty menbo' with a pink face silhouette. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail environment. (3) The creator holds a stack of individually wrapped silver cotton swabs. They pull one from the package and tear it open against a clean white table background. Detailed text overlays describe the packaging count and the liquid ingredients within the swabs. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the cotton swab itself, showing a pointed tip on one end and a standard rounded tip on the other. The lighting emphasizes the fibrous texture of the cotton. Text describes the specific precision and area cleaning functions of the two ends. (5) Back on the hand with the red swatches, the creator demonstrates using the rounded tip for broad wiping and the pointed tip for correcting a dark eyeliner wing drawn on the skin. A rating scale and recommendation index appear at the end. (6) The final screen displays a pink circular logo for Japanuts with various social media handles and icons. Text prompts viewers to like, comment, and share. The background is a soft pink and white gradient.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy J-pop music with a prominent male vocal and electric guitar riffs begins immediately. The sound of plastic rustling is heard as the product packaging is handled. The tempo is brisk at approximately 130 BPM with a clear percussive backbeat. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect triggers precisely as a new text overlay appears on screen. The BGM maintains its upbeat energy with high-pitched synthesizer layers. There is no spoken narration, only the Japanese vocal track within the music. (3) A subtle mechanical click and tearing sound are audible when the individual cotton swab wrapper is opened. The music transitions into a pre-chorus with rising harmonic tension and increased spectral brightness. The ambient noise floor remains extremely clean. (4) A 'sparkle' sound effect accompanies the visual demonstration of clean makeup removal. The BGM swells into a melodic chorus with steady kick drum hits. The male singer's voice remains energetic and clear. Occasional digital UI-style pings emphasize technical features. (5) The high-arousal musical track continues until the very end, concluding with a hard cut. The mix remains balanced, prioritizing the energetic J-pop track and synchronized sound effects over any background room tone.
